page.overview:
Who is Defeated Invincible?

Global Defense Agency Caitlin Stedman Denise Ferguson

Markus Sebastian "Mark" Grayson, better known as Defeated Invincible, is an evil variant of the main Invincible and a minor antagonist in the second season of Invincible.

Like many alternate versions of Mark, he accepted his father Nolan Grayson's offer to join the Viltrumite Empire, helping him wage war across Earth. Unlike most of his counterparts, however, he failed to conquer the planet. Global military forces eventually defeated both him and Omni-Man. Nolan was killed by experimental quantum bombs that devastated much of Europe, while Mark was gradually worn down by the combined resistance. Once exhaustion finally forced him to sleep, the Global Defense Agency seized the opportunity to capture him and imprison him in one of its highest-security facilities.

At some point, this variant of Invincible was visited by a multiverse hopping Angstrom who was seeking revenge on the mainstream Invincible. Angstrom promised the variant he would free him if he gave him information, though he quickly went back on it and left the variant in his prison.
